name: Ad to page check
summary: When a campaign's landing page is ready for a prelaunch check, the acquisition owner gets a findings list that sets each ad beside the captured page: message, offer details, form and next step, on mobile and desktop. Page states nobody captured are marked unknown.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of advertising and lead generation work, and its own method for comparing a campaign's ads with the captured landing page before launch.
